description: Check one proposed name against the US, EU and Israeli trademark registers read by Open Trademarks, and report live marks that conflict. A register search is not legal advice and no answer clears a name.

classes.description: Nice classes to check, each 1 to 45.

goods.description: What the name is for, in plain words. Open Trademarks maps it to Nice classes.

name.description: The proposed name, 2 to 120 characters. One name per call.

registers.description: A subset of us, eu, il. All three when left out (default).

name: check_trademark
